name: 咔咔壳
evolution: 板板壳 → 咔咔壳 Lv.16 → 水泡壳 Lv.36
description: 很少再缩进壳里，即使遇到危险也会勇敢面对。甲壳内一部分是空气，一部分是水，通过喷嘴来调节重量从而在水中下潜和上浮。
descriptionEn: It rarely retreats into its shell anymore, and faces danger bravely. Part of the inside of its carapace is air and part is water; it adjusts its weight through a nozzle to dive and surface in water.
